title: Aria the Scarlet Ammo Returns With a New Short Anime, Corto
excerpt:
Kadokawa is reviving Aria the Scarlet Ammo for its fifteenth anniversary.
The new short anime is planned for 2027 with returning voice actors.
body_md:
Kadokawa has announced Aria the Scarlet Ammo Corto, a new short anime celebrating fifteen years since the original television adaptation premiered. The project is scheduled for 2027, although no precise premiere date or international distribution arrangement has been announced.

The franchise originated with light novels written by Chugaku Akamatsu and illustrated by Kobuichi. Its setting features a school that trains students in armed combat and specialized tactical skills. Kinji Toyama becomes involved with the formidable Aria H. Kanzaki after an assassin targets him.

Several familiar performers are returning. Rie Kugimiya will again voice Aria, while Junji Majima reprises Kinji. Mikako Takahashi, Mariya Ise, Kaori Ishihara and Ayako Kawasumi are also among the announced returning cast members.

New cast additions include Emiri Iwai, Miyari Nemoto and Anzu Haruno. Akamatsu is supervising the screenplay alongside Kenji Saito, while Yoshifumi Sasahara is directing at BELLNOX FILMS. The production therefore combines continuity in its characters and voices with a different creative team.

The original television anime debuted in 2011. A later animated installment focused more on a spin-off storyline, making this revival particularly notable to viewers interested in the central cast. Nevertheless, Corto has specifically been described as a short anime, not a confirmed full-length season.

An initial visual has been revealed, but the episode count, running time and worldwide streaming arrangements remain unknown. For now, the confirmed development is a 2027 return rather than a fully detailed release plan.

seo_description: Kadokawa announces Aria the Scarlet Ammo Corto, a short anime revival featuring returning cast members and a new production team.
